北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感 6℃ 有些凉，风干物燥，记得多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear. It feels 6℃, a bit cool and dry. Remember to drink more water!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 6℃，风力 4级较大。出门添衣，小心着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels 6℃ with a strong 4-level wind. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雨，气温 10℃。带好雨具，注意防湿防滑哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: It's raining in Shanghai, with a temperature of 10℃. Take your umbrella and watch out for wet, slippery surfaces!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 28℃，体感舒适。注意防晒，保持清爽！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, 28℃, feeling comfortable. Remember sun protection and stay refreshed!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 25℃ 略热。注意补水，保持好心情呀！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 25℃, a bit warm. Remember to hydrate and stay in a good mood!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，体感 6℃ 有些冷。雨天路滑，出行多加小心！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain, feels 6℃, a bit cold. Roads are slippery, please be careful when traveling!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 4℃ 湿冷。湿度 100%，务必注意保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels 4℃, damp and cold. 100% humidity, be sure to stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 14℃ 体感适中。记得添衣，以防着凉哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 14℃, feels moderate. Remember to add layers to avoid catching a cold!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低。出行注意安全，保持车距哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has fog, visibility is low. Drive safely and maintain distance!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 9℃，空气干燥。注意保湿，多喝水哟！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels 9℃, and the air is dry. Remember to moisturize and drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 14℃。天气略凉，出门多穿件外套吧！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels 14℃. It's a bit cool, so wear an extra jacket when you go out!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 -9℃，风力 5级。天寒地冻，务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feels -9℃ with a strong 5-level wind. It's freezing, be sure to bundle up completely!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -1℃。风力虽小，仍需注意防寒保暖哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear, feels -1℃. Although the wind is light, still remember to keep warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 13℃。早晚温差大，记得及时添减衣物！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels 13℃. Large temperature difference between morning and evening, remember to adjust your clothing!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 22℃，温度适宜。微风拂面， Enjoy 惬意时光！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels 22℃, a comfortable temperature. Gentle breeze, enjoy the pleasant time!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 2℃，风力 4级。海风较大，注意防风保暖哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels 2℃ with a strong 4-level wind. Sea breeze is strong, remember to protect yourself from wind and cold!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -2℃，北风 4级。风寒效应明显，做好防寒！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels -2℃ with a 4-level north wind. Wind chill is significant, be sure to stay warm!
